summary: Cavite 1st District representative with 209 principal-authored bills. Authored a P200 daily wage increase, a national minimum wage, stronger security of tenure, 15 days of paid serious-illness leave, protection and incentives for freelancers, higher public teacher pay, civil service eligibility for casuals, exemption of migrant workers from PhilHealth contributions, free professional exams for indigent Filipinos and a VAT exemption on 200 kWh household electricity. Also authored a deepfake prohibition.
caveat: Deepfake and workplace anti-discrimination bills are each a single issue and left unscored. Bill-based evidence only.

economic.label: Center-left
economic.rationale: Authored a P200 wage increase, minimum wage system, security of tenure, sick leave and freelancer protections (-2 to -3), higher public teacher pay (-2), free exams for indigent Filipinos and migrant PhilHealth exemption (-2) and a VAT exemption (-1).
